separation: This is a new foreign value/ownership contract. It does not silently extend psc-runtime-values/1, change VerifiedIR meanings, or close the external ABI validation gap.
validation: Unique conservative lowercase kebab identifiers, resolved acyclic type graph, resource-only handles, supported target presence, exact imported/exported interface resolution and declared capability policy. Depth exhaustion is a separate failure. Every WIT emission freshly validates its raw input.
borrowProfile: Only direct synchronous function parameters may borrow a resource. Borrowed results, nested borrows and async borrows are unsupported and rejected. Resource values require explicit own or borrow in the model.

wit.output: Deterministic package, interface and world declarations with percent-escaped identifiers, named aggregates, resource handles, results, futures and streams. Owned resources use the WIT resource-name shorthand.
wit.independentParserValidation: pending external Component Model parser; independent in-repo renderer relation implemented
wit.independentRelationValidation: scripts/interface-ir-artifact.mjs independently decodes canonical InterfaceIR, re-renders deterministic WIT, and requires exact supplied WIT bytes; psc-interface-ir-wit-rendering/1 does not establish Canonical ABI or runtime behavior.

authority: A validated interface and emitted declaration are data, not CheckedCore, executable compatibility evidence, a preservation theorem or release acceptance.
remaining: Canonical ABI/component binary lowering and runtime adapters
VerifiedIR link integration with actual target adapters
